integrity: Mathematical proof and independently implemented finite-field checks accompany the claim; the finite checks do not prove its unrestricted statement.
scientific_limitations: The invariant is the abstract commuting-idempotent scheme, not a marked embedding in a matrix affine space.
The four-vertex minimality is within connected height-one posets, up to isomorphism or anti-isomorphism.
Earlier literature on simultaneous diagonalization and single-idempotent strata provides substantial antecedents; priority beyond inspected texts is uncertain.
title: Commuting-idempotent schemes of incidence algebras as Tutte invariants, with a sharp four-point reconstruction failure
